verdict.rationale: Eqvista sells 409A valuations alongside its cap table. Clients get unlimited 409A valuations for 12 months from NACVA-certified analysts, which covers repeat refreshes, plus paid expedite options. It also offers a real-time, app-based view of common stock value, with a menu to enable it, that replaces static 409A reports. This implies valuations are tied to the live platform data. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that valuations are generated directly from live cap table data, a documented scheduled or automatic refresh cadence, an in-app ordering workflow, explicit audit-ready or safe-harbor defensibility claims, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the 409A service.
